basic_details.job_title: Lucknow University Subject Expert Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | subject expert (forensic chemistry & toxicology, forensic anthropology, digital & cyber forensics): As per UGC guidelines and University norms. Preference will be given to candidates specialized in Forensic Chemistry & Toxicology, Forensic Anthropology (to teach both in Anthropology/Forensic Science Program), and Digital & Cyber Forensics.

how_to_apply: Check eligibility according to UGC guidelines and University norms in the preferred specialization field.
Prepare a complete CV or resume.
Gather all original testimonials along with a set of photocopies.
Keep a recent passport-size photograph ready.
Report to the Department of Anthropology, University of Lucknow, Lucknow, 30 minutes before the scheduled interview time.
Attend the walk-in interview on 16 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.
important_instructions: Candidate should report 30 minutes before the scheduled time at the department. Candidates must carry their CV or resume along with all original testimonials and a set of photocopies. A recent passport-size photograph must be carried. No TA/DA will be paid to any candidate for the walk-in interview. Candidates must refer to the university website for any update.
